## Outcome

Describe the user-visible or operator-visible result and the problem it solves.

## Related issue

Link the issue this change addresses, for example `Closes #123`. Write `None`
when no issue exists.

## Trust and compatibility impact

Describe affected credentials, isolation, storage, protocol, release, or GitHub
Actions compatibility boundaries. Write `None` only after checking them.

## Verification

List the exact checks run and their results. Note any relevant test that was not
run and why.

## AI assistance

If an AI tool materially contributed to this change, name the tool and briefly
describe its role. Write `None` if this does not apply. Routine completion,
spelling, and grammar assistance do not need disclosure.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the owning public boundary or the change is documentation-only.
- [ ] User-facing documentation and compatibility status are updated where needed.
- [ ] Logs, fixtures, screenshots, and examples contain no secrets or private data.
- [ ] New dependencies, generated assets, licenses, and release metadata are accounted for.
- [ ] Unsupported workflow behavior is rejected explicitly rather than ignored.
- [ ] I reviewed and understand every submitted change, including AI-assisted work.
